TOP ROW is the SAME child host Xiaohe in three poses: a gender-neutral Chinese child aged 6 with short dark rounded bob hair, round peach face, rosy cheeks, tiny dark dot eyes, mustard-yellow long-sleeve shirt, moss-green short overalls with a little leaf badge, cream socks, brown round shoes, tiny brown book backpack. Top left warmly waving with one hand, top center thinking with hand at chin, top right presenting a small open book. BOTTOM ROW is the SAME Chinese adult farmer in three poses: kind round peach face, rosy cheeks, short dark hair and small eyebrows, round straw hat with dark brown band, muted terracotta tunic with cream cuffs and belt, navy-blue loose trousers, brown cloth shoes, no beard. Bottom left standing curious with hands on hips, bottom center bending over with BOTH hands reaching downward together to gently grasp an imaginary seedling (do NOT draw any plant), bottom right crouching, looking concerned and holding one hand near his cheek. Each character full body visible and centered in its own cell, consistent identity, costume and proportions across its three poses. Normal anatomy, clear readable silhouettes, emotionally gentle. These are separate animation sprites, not a comic scene. Transparent background including between cells, no shadows outside character, no objects besides the host's book/backpack and farmer's straw hat, no text or decorative elements.
